JUST FINISHED MONSTERS WE MAKE!! Def gotta make fanart. THE CHARACTERS were the best part of the manga for me, obviously. Gosh, their motivations, their struggles, the impossible situation they’ve been put in is amazing. 

GOD I LOVE THEM SO MUCH I’m so interested to see where this goes! I’m gonna keep a watch on Liam though, he’s hiding a lot…. LOVE Jabari and Ali’s dynamic, I love that this type of rivalry is something you’d see with two guys traditionally in anime, it’s nice to have such a strong woman. THE DIALOGUE WAS SO GOOD btw. Favorite part of the entire manga. 

If anything, I think that the speech bubbles were a little difficult to understand who was talking or communicating at times, and I got lost once or twice trying to understand which dialogue bubble was first, but well done Cory and Team! Will be getting the second volume for sure
